   10 ;"19.07.1994" 64.A94 
   20 ;"27.10.1995" ADDING DROP FUNCTION
   30 ;64.A95 - FILE
   40 ; 64_CHR_PRINT_WINDOW_DRIVER 
   50 *D+
   60 ;       ORG  #F000
   70        ORG  63650    ;FOR "C" PROGRAMM
   80 
   90 
  100 CHRCOD DEFB #20      ;SPASE
  110 ROW    DEFB 05
  120 LIN    DEFB 5
  130 ;WINDOW COORDINATES
  140 FROW   DEFB 05
  150 LROW   DEFB 54
  160 FLIN   DEFB 5
  170 LLIN   DEFB 10
  180 ;FONT ADDRES 
  190 FO_ADR DEFW FONT
  200        ENT  $
  210 
  220 ; ***** FUNCTIONS *******
  230 ;PRINT CHR SUBROUTINE
  240 PRCHR: DI
  250        CALL GO
  260        EI
  270        RET
  280 ;SCROLL WINDOW UP ON ONE LINE
  290 W_UP:  DI
  300        CALL WSCRUP
  310        EI
  320        RET
  330 ;SCROLL WINDOW DOWN ON ONE LINE
  340 W_DWN: DI
  350        CALL WSCRD
  360        EI
  370        RET
  380 
  390 DROP   DEFB #01      ;DROPS LONG LINES AVAIBLE
  400 ;IF DROP=0 NOT PRINT ENDING TO BIG LINES 
  410 SCRPOS DEFW #4000
  420 FLAG_1 DEFB #01
  430 LFA16  DEFB #00
  440 
  450 CHRBUF DEFB #00,#00,#00,#00,#00,#00,#00,#00
  460 
  470 
  480 GO:    PUSH IX
  490        LD   A,(ROW)
  500        LD   C,A
  510        LD   A,(LROW)
  520        CP   C
  530        JR   NC,L1    ;ROW<LROW
  540 ; NEXT LINE
  560        LD   A,(DROP)
  570        CP   0
  580        JR   Z,L0     ;NOT PRINT ENDING TOO BIG LINES
  600        LD   A,(FROW)
  610        LD   (ROW),A
  620        LD   A,(LIN)
  630        LD   C,A
  640        LD   A,(LLIN)
  650        CP   C
  660        JR   Z,L4     ;LAST LINE IN WINDOW
  670        JR   NC,L2    ;LIN<LLIN
  680 ; NOW SCROLL WINDOW
  690 L4:    CALL WSCRUP   ;SCROLL WINDOW 
  700 ;       LD   A,(LLIN)
  710 ;       LD   (LIN),A
  720        JR   L3
  730 
  740 L2:    LD   A,C
  750        INC  A
  760        LD   (LIN),A  ;NEXT LIN
  770 L3:    NOP
  780 L1:    NOP
  790 
  800        CALL SETPOS
  810 
  820        CALL P_CHR
  830 
  840        LD   A,(ROW)
  850        INC  A
  860        LD   (ROW),A
  870 
  880 L0:    POP  IX
  890        RET
  900 ;SET AT COODINATES B=LIN(1-24),C=ROW(1-32)
  910 SETPOS LD   A,(ROW)
  920        LD   C,A
  930        LD   A,(LIN)
  940        LD   B,A
  950        LD   A,B
  960        RRCA
  970        RRCA
  980        RRCA
  990        AND  #E0
 1000        LD   L,A
 1010        LD   A,B
 1020        AND  #18
 1030        OR   #40
 1040        LD   H,A
 1050        BIT  0,C
 1060        JR   NZ,SA1
 1070        XOR  A
 1080        LD   (LFA16),A
 1090        JR   SA2
 1100 SA1:   LD   A,#01
 1110        LD   (LFA16),A
 1120 SA2:   SRL  C
 1130        LD   A,C
 1140        ADD  A,L
 1150        LD   L,A
 1160        LD   (SCRPOS),HL
 1170        RET
 1180 
 1190 ; PRINT SIMBOL IN "A"
 1200 P_CHR: LD   A,(CHRCOD)
 1210 
 1220        LD   BC,(FO_ADR);FONT_ADR 
 1230 
 1240 
 1250 ; FIND ADR CHR IN GNAKO_GENERATOR
 1260        LD   E,#00
 1270        RRA
 1280        RL   E
 1290        ADD  A,A
 1300        LD   L,A
 1310        LD   H,#00
 1320        ADD  HL,HL
 1330        ADD  HL,HL
 1340        ADD  HL,BC    ;ADR CHR IN GNAKOGENERATOR
 1350        XOR  A
 1360        CP   E
 1370        LD   DE,CHRBUF
 1380        PUSH DE
 1390 
 1400        LD   B,#08
 1410        JR   Z,LFA5E
 1420 LFA52  LD   A,(HL)   ;IF NOT PARITY COD
 1430        ADD  A,A
 1440        ADD  A,A
 1450        ADD  A,A
 1460        ADD  A,A
 1470        LD   (DE),A
 1480        INC  HL
 1490        INC  DE
 1500        DJNZ LFA52
 1510 ;       XOR  A
 1520 ;       LD   (LFA16),A
 1530        JR   LFA66
 1540 LFA5E  LD   A,(HL)   ;IF PARITY COD
 1550        AND  #F0
 1560        LD   (DE),A
 1570        INC  HL
 1580        INC  DE
 1590        DJNZ LFA5E
 1600 ;       LD   A,1
 1610 ;       LD   (LFA16),A
 1620 
 1630 LFA66  POP  IX
 1640 
 1650 
 1660        LD   A,(LFA16) ;PARITY FLAG
 1670        LD   C,A
 1680 
 1690        LD   HL,(SCRPOS)
 1700        LD   B,#08    ;COUNT 8 BYTES
 1710 LFA97  LD   A,(FLAG_1) ;FLAG_1
 1720        LD   E,A
 1730 LFAA0  RRA
 1740        RRA
 1750        SBC  A,A
 1760        AND  #F0
 1770        XOR  (IX+0)   ;CHR_BUFF ADR
 1780        LD   D,A
 1790        XOR  A
 1800        CP   C
 1810        LD   A,#0F
 1820        JR   Z,LFAB7  ;FOR NOT PARITY CHR
 1830        LD   A,D      ;FOR PARITY CHR
 1840        RRCA
 1850        RRCA
 1860        RRCA
 1870        RRCA
 1880        LD   D,A
 1890        LD   A,#F0
 1900 LFAB7  OR   E
 1910        AND  (HL)     ; ADR ON SCREEN
 1920        OR   D
 1930        LD   (HL),A
 1940        INC  IX       ;NEXT CHR BYTE IMAGE
 1950        INC  H        ; NEXT LINE ON SCREEN
 1960        DJNZ LFA97
 1970 ; ONE CHR IS READY ON SCREEN
 1980 ; NOW ATTIBYTE
 1990 ;       DEC  H        ;OLD SCR ADR
 2000 ;       CALL #0BDB    ;SET ATTRIBYTE
 2010 ; TOGGLE PARITY FLAG
 2020        LD   A,#FF
 2030        XOR  C
 2040        LD   (LFA16),A
 2050        RET
 2060 ;SCROLL WINDOW SUBROUTINE
 2070 
 2080 UP     DEFB #00
 2090 DOWN   DEFB #00
 2100 LEFT   DEFB #00
 2110 RIGHT  DEFB #00
 2120 ADRUP  DEFW #0000
 2130 ADRDWN DEFW #0000
 2140 LEN    DEFB #00
 2150 
 2160 W_SET: LD   A,(FLIN)
 2170        LD   (UP),A
 2180        LD   A,(LLIN)
 2190        LD   (DOWN),A
 2200        LD   A,(FROW)
 2210        SRL  A
 2220        LD   (LEFT),A
 2230        LD   B,A
 2240        LD   A,(LROW)
 2250        SRL  A
 2260        LD   (RIGHT),A
 2270        SUB  B        ;RIGHT-LEFT=LEN
 2280        INC  A
 2290        LD   (LEN),A
 2300        RET
 2310 
 2320 WSCRUP CALL W_SET
 2330 SCRL:  LD   A,(UP)
 2340        INC  A
 2350        LD   (UP),A
 2360        LD   B,A      ;NEXT LIN IS END ?
 2370        LD   A,(DOWN)
 2380        CP   B        ;UP+1=DOWN ?
 2390        JP   C,EXT_UP   ;SCROLL END EXIT
 2400 
 2410        LD   A,(LEFT)
 2420        LD   C,A
 2430        LD   A,(UP)
 2440        DEC  A
 2450        LD   B,A
 2460        CALL ADDR
 2470        LD   (ADRUP),HL
 2480 
 2490        LD   A,(LEFT)
 2500        LD   C,A
 2510        LD   A,(UP)
 2520        LD   B,A
 2530        CALL ADDR
 2540        LD   (ADRDWN),HL
 2550 
 2560        LD   B,#08
 2570 SCRLN: PUSH BC
 2580        LD   HL,(ADRUP)
 2590        EX   DE,HL
 2600        LD   HL,(ADRDWN)
 2610        LD   BC,(LEN)
 2620        XOR  A
 2630        LD   B,A
 2640        LDIR
 2650        LD   A,(ADRUP+1)
 2660        INC  A
 2670        LD   (ADRUP+1),A
 2680        LD   A,(ADRDWN+1)
 2690        INC  A
 2700        LD   (ADRDWN+1),A
 2710        POP  BC
 2720        DJNZ SCRLN
 2730        JP   SCRL
 2740 
 2750 WSCRD: CALL W_SET
 2760 SCRLD: LD   A,(UP)
 2770        LD   B,A
 2780        LD   A,(DOWN)
 2790        DEC  A
 2800        LD   (DOWN),A
 2810        CP   B
 2820        JR   C,EXT_DN
 2830 
 2840        LD   A,(LEFT)
 2850        LD   C,A
 2860        LD   A,(DOWN)
 2870        INC  A
 2880        LD   B,A
 2890        CALL ADDR
 2900        LD   (ADRDWN),HL
 2910 
 2920        LD   A,(LEFT)
 2930        LD   C,A
 2940        LD   A,(DOWN)
 2950        LD   B,A
 2960        CALL ADDR
 2970        LD   (ADRUP),HL
 2980 
 2990        LD   B,#08
 3000 SCRLN2 PUSH BC
 3010        LD   HL,(ADRDWN)
 3020        EX   DE,HL
 3030        LD   HL,(ADRUP)
 3040        LD   BC,(LEN)
 3050        XOR  A
 3060        LD   B,A
 3070        LDIR
 3080        LD   A,(ADRUP+1)
 3090        INC  A
 3100        LD   (ADRUP+1),A
 3110        LD   A,(ADRDWN+1)
 3120        INC  A
 3130        LD   (ADRDWN+1),A
 3140        POP  BC
 3150        DJNZ SCRLN2
 3160        JP   SCRLD
 3170

 3260 
 3270 ;CALCULATE ADDRES OF WINDOW LINE
 3280 ADDR:  NOP
 3290        LD   A,B
 3300        RRCA
 3310        RRCA
 3320        RRCA
 3330        AND  #E0
 3340        ADD  A,C
 3350        LD   L,A
 3360        LD   A,B
 3370        AND  #18
 3380        OR   #40
 3390        LD   H,A
 3400        RET  ;ADDRES IN "HL"
 3410 
 3420 EXT_DN LD   A,(UP)
 3430        LD   B,A
 3440        JR   EXT_
 3450 EXT_UP LD   A,(DOWN)
 3460        LD   B,A
 3470 EXT_:  LD   A,(LEFT)
 3480        LD   C,A
 3490        CALL ADDR
 3500        LD   B,#08
 3510 CLS2:  PUSH BC       ;CLS DOWN LINE
 3520        PUSH HL
 3530        LD   A,(LEN)
 3540        LD   B,A
 3550        XOR  A
 3560 CLS1:  LD   (HL),A
 3570        INC  HL
 3580        DJNZ CLS1
 3590        POP  HL
 3600        INC  H
 3610        POP  BC
 3620        DJNZ CLS2
 3630 
 3640        RET
